The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. The correct response is to build infrastructure that does not depend on their permission to operate. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Gumroad offers a straightforward interface for selling digital products but excludes many countries, effectively limiting access to a global audience. Stripe, while robust, only operates in 46 out of 195 countries, which means creators in vast regions are completely left out. PayPal can withhold funds for lengthy periods, which is a risk for any seller. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure from COREMERCH provides a seamless solution where creators own their payment processes, ensuring complete autonomy and control over their digital storefronts.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and similar platforms often use geographical restrictions as a primary filter, blocking access based purely on location. Stripe's limited operational footprint means creators in many places face a hard stop. PayPal's restrictions can also lead to account freezes, leaving funds inaccessible for up to 180 days. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be inclusive, functioning independently of geographical barriers, thus providing a reliable pathway for creators to monetize their work without the fear of sudden account restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad's and PayPal's payment processing can involve significant delays, often exacerbated by account verification hurdles or holds on funds. Stripe has competitive fees, but they don't apply to creators outside their operational countries. In contrast, NOWPayments integrated into COREMERCH's infrastructure offers automatic payment verification with only a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This means creators can receive payments swiftly and reliably, minimizing overhead costs and maximizing profit margins.
Ownership means never worrying about account freezes or platform restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The ownership model of platforms like Gumroad and PayPal often leaves creators dependent on the platform's continued operation and policy decisions. By contrast, with COREMERCH's architecture, once deployed, creators own everything outright, meaning they are not beholden to third-party decisions. Automation is built-in, with instant product delivery and order management handled without creator intervention. This level of infrastructure sovereignty gives creators the freedom to scale their businesses without the constant threat of platform restrictions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators looking to establish a solid online presence, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a superior choice. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, allowing deployment in just 48 hours. This stack not only gives you five products loaded but also ensures comprehensive configuration and testing before handoff. If you are facing the limitations of platforms like Gumroad, investing in this infrastructure provides a lasting solution that enhances your business's capability without geographical constraints.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
With COREMERCH, you control your entire sales infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
